catalog.summary: Directs scripted cinematic ads, commercials and branded films from an ordinary-language brief, where a written script drives the images.
Directs phone-shot UGC, influencer and testimonial ads from an ordinary-language brief, with one person talking to their own camera.
Translate a rendered blocking clip into a video prompt that preserves its camera, cuts, timing and spatial relationships.
Build or refine Blender camera rigs for a previs pass: orbits, floor rises, whip-and-lock moves, handheld, speed ramps and shot transitions.
Prepare and bind a reusable character identity sheet from an image or description.
Generate and save images through a connected ChatGPT account or the host image tool, preserving Slates prompts, references and project context.
Choose lighting, exposure, grade, lens, atmosphere and imperfection techniques for a filmed look.
Check provider-sensitive content before prompting a brief with conflict, creatures, crowds, violence, destruction, weapons, real likenesses or young characters.
Estimate and announce generation spend, aggregate batches, follow existing consent and inspect uncertain jobs before retrying.
Block a multi-character conversation (at a table, in a car, walking) in Blender when seating, eyelines or screen direction must hold across cuts, or generation has lost that continuity.
Develop a product-led direct-response ad from an offer and references.
Refine an existing Slates image with a targeted edit or revised generation.
Choose image, video, edit and audio models for the brief, including animating photos, making films or directing voices.
Turn a video brief into a finished, editable Slates production and verified export.
Build and render a Blender blocking pass for precise camera paths, cut timing or spatial continuity, then guide video generation with the clip.
Navigate and organize Slates projects, asset codes such as IMG-A12 or VID-V3, folders, Library references and templates.

Direct speech with Inworld Realtime TTS-2 (inworld-tts-2).
Prompt Kling V3.0 video generation and Kling O3 video edits.

Prompt LTX-2.5 or LTX-2.5 Pro (ltx-2-5, ltx-2-5-pro) with slates_generate_video.
Prompt MiniMax H3, H3 Max or H3 Max Turbo with slates_generate_video.

Prompt Nano Banana 2, Lite or Pro image generation and edits.
Prompt Gemini Omni Flash video generation or Omni Flash edits (omni-flash, omni-flash-edit).
Prompt Seed Audio 1.0 (seed-audio) with slates_generate_audio.
Prompt Seedance 2.5 generation (seedance-2.5) or edits (seedance-2.5-edit).

Translate a visual-style brief into model-specific image or video direction and maintain the look across shots.
Direct a creator-style spoken ad when the brief calls for a camera-facing person or exchange.
Inspect generated media against the brief, diagnose defects and choose a targeted correction.
